name: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank
tagline: Small finance bank posting a sharp post-microfinance-stress turnaround (Q1 FY27 PAT +207% YoY, RoA 2.2%, RoE 18.2%) at an undemanding ~1.85x book / ~14x P/E - a genuine, cheap operating recovery, but a 10x-in-2-3-years from a ~Rs 12,600 Cr bank is not a credible mechanism; RBI has returned the universal-bank-licence application
business_overview: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank serves mass-market and MSME customers with a microfinance-heritage lending book that is diversifying into secured retail and MSME loans (secured share 49.4% of the ~Rs 40,655 Cr gross book, up from 43.5% a year ago). Reverse-merged with its holding company (Ujjivan Financial Services) in 2025, so it is now promoter-less / board-controlled. Recovering from the sector-wide microfinance asset-quality stress cycle of FY25.

GNPA 2.17% / NNPA 0.34%, PCR 85% - improving off the FY25 stress
Total income Rs 8,039 Cr (+12%), PAT Rs 693 Cr; gross loan book Rs 40,655 Cr (+27%), deposits >Rs 40,000 Cr; GNPA 2.27%
Advances growth ~25%; RoA raised to 1.8-2.0%; credit cost cut to 0.9-1.0% of avg assets
Rs 2,000 Cr QIP planned (Sep 2026); universal-bank-licence application RETURNED by RBI, told to reapply after further book diversification
fundamentals_narrative: The operating turnaround is unambiguous and fast: Q1 FY27 NII +38.6% YoY, PAT +207% YoY (Rs 317 Cr), RoA 2.2%, RoE 18.2%, NIM 8.5%, with GNPA/NNPA down to 2.17%/0.34% and PCR at 85%. FY26 closed with PAT Rs 693 Cr, the gross loan book at Rs 40,655 Cr (+27%) and the secured share up to 49.4%. Management has raised FY27 RoA guidance to 1.8-2.0% and cut credit-cost guidance. Valuation is undemanding - ~1.85x book and ~14x trailing P/E for a bank running an ~18% RoE. Two offsets: (1) the RBI returned Ujjivan's universal-bank-licence application, asking it to diversify further before reapplying - a timing setback to the re-rating optionality; and (2) a Rs 2,000 Cr QIP will dilute book value per share near-term. The stock is near a 52-week high after a ~64% one-year run. As a screen candidate, this is a genuine, cheap turnaround worth tracking - but a 10x in 2-3 years from a Rs 12,600 Cr bank would require ~10x book/earnings compounding that no SFB delivers on that horizon, so the return-magnitude label does not fit.
technical_read: Stock near its 52-week high after a strong one-year run (+~64%); a clear uptrend as the market re-rates the post-stress recovery.

verdict_headline: Deep-dive pass 1: genuine, cheap operating turnaround (Q1 FY27 PAT +207%, RoA 2.2%, ~1.85x book) - but four_box scores 1.5 and a 10x-in-2-3-years from a Rs 12,600 Cr bank is not a credible mechanism, so thesis_fit moves to neither; conviction held Medium on the business, not the return label. Universal-bank-licence application returned by RBI.
verdict_reasoning: four_box scores 1.5: tailwind weak (no structural sector tailwind - the SFB/MFI segment just came through a stress cycle; this is the bank's own idiosyncratic recovery), tam weak (small mcap gives re-rating room for a normal 2-3x thesis, but not the headroom for a 10x off earnings/book in 2-3 years), moat no (SFBs have no durable moat; deposit franchise still building), valuation weak (~1.85x book / ~14x P/E is reasonable-to-cheap for an 18% RoE, but the stock is near a 52-wk high after +64% and a QIP dilution is coming). Score 1.5 -> thesis_fit 'neither', hard, no exception.

The operating turnaround is real and best-in-batch on momentum (PAT +207% YoY, RoA guidance raised to 1.8-2.0%, credit cost cut, GNPA 2.17%), and the valuation is undemanding - so conviction is held at Medium as a quality-recovery-at-a-fair-price, but the 10x/100x return label is withdrawn on the size/mechanism math, not on business quality.

RBI returned the universal-bank-licence application (Sep 2026), asking for further book diversification before reapplying - this defers the single biggest re-rating catalyst; a Rs 2,000 Cr QIP is also pending.

No red flag; no trusted-roster conviction floor. Re-check trigger: two-three more quarters of ~2% RoA holding through-cycle, secured mix past ~55%, and a fresh universal-licence application accepted for review.
